title: ר' יוסי בן פטרוס סוי

paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Petros, with the extra word סוי, Shemot Rabbah, section 52; the word סוי is a scribal error. See Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi above. Jerusalem Talmud, Moed Katan, Megalchin, halakhah 5: Rabbi Yose ben Petros, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s father-in-law, suffered an incident—meaning a bereavement. Bar Kappara sent him two students to study with him. We do not know whether it was generally permitted or permitted because he was eager for Torah, for we learned that if he was eager for Torah, it was permitted. Rabbah, beginning of Tzav, section 7: ‘Zavdi ben Levi, Rabbi Yose ben Tartas, and the sages, one said,’ and so forth; it should read Petros. Bereshit Rabbah, Vayiggash, section 94: ‘Bar Kappara and Rabbi Yosef bar Petros’; it should read Rabbi Yose. Bereshit Rabbah, Mikketz, section 91: Zavdi ben Levi—see his entry—Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, and Rabbi Yose bar Petros, all three said these verses as they died.
